verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a cloud database with a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out setting. Local-only databases, customer-held encryption keys and data residency are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
